description: This Java class serves as a form backing bean in a web application for uploading digital product files. It holds data related to uploaded files, the associated digital product, and the related product entity, including validation annotations to ensure data integrity.

classes.name: ProductFiles
classes.description: A bean class responsible for capturing form data for uploading digital product files, with validation and serialization support.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the list of uploaded multipart files.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the list of uploaded multipart files.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with this form.
